name: automation-recipes
title: Automation recipes
description: Ready-made automations as trigger and action rows: when this happens, do that, with the apps named and a button to use the recipe, under tabs by team.
docs: Pass recipes (an id, an outcome, a trigger with app and event, and one to three actions with app and action) and onUse, which is called with the recipe's id and the recipe when its button is pressed; the block starts nothing itself. Add groups (an id and a label each, with a group on every recipe) to put the recipes under tabs by team. Each row is a list item with the outcome as its heading, and app names are plain text with no logos. The chips wrap on a narrow block and the arrow turns to point down. Use defaultGroup, or group and onGroupChange, to choose the tab. Words are translated through labels.
